Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like your sharper customer focus makes long-term commitment especially valuable in this renewal. We value the relationship and want to build on your offer of cost transparency to reach a straightforward agreement. How could you share the cost breakdown in XLSX so we can establish pricing that reflects both your cost drivers and the value of a longer agreement?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 24 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. Our recent orders for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 were at 4.29, 4.39 per 1 (po:4500014329-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014467-10). Our demand forecast for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.79 per unit, 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We welcome your commitment to a 24-month agreement and the 14-day payment terms.
Please understand that our detailed cost breakdown is confidential and cannot be shared.
In response to the adjusted terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 4.87 per unit.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like contractual continuity and prompt payment made your price adjustment possible, rather than the historical comparisons. We respect the confidentiality of your calculation and want a straightforward renewal that gives both sides certainty. What room remains on price to bring this renewal to agreement?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 24 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +0.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.80 per unit, 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
